saints.name: Sts. Cosmas and Damian
saints.title: Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: Twin physicians who healed the sick without payment for the love of Christ, and were crowned with martyrdom…
biography: Cosmas and Damian, held by tradition to be twin brothers of Arabia, practised medicine in Syria and would take no fee for their care of the sick, so that they were called the "moneyless ones." Their charity won many to the faith.

In the persecution of Diocletian they were arrested, tortured, and beheaded, about the year 287, at Cyrrhus, which became the centre of their cult. Honoured as patrons of physicians and the sick, their names are inscribed in the Roman canon of the Mass.
saints.knownFor: Healing the sick without charge and their martyrdom for the faith.
